title: Portuguese greetings and basics
examples: How do I say good morning in Portuguese?
Is 'obrigado' the same for boys and girls?
What is the difference between Brazilian and European Portuguese?

explain.say: Today we learn some simple Portuguese greetings. Say olá. Olá means hello in Portuguese.
Next we learn how to say thank you. If you are a boy you say obrigado. If you are a girl you say obrigada.
Let us learn to say goodbye. A common way is até logo. It means see you later.
Brazil and Portugal speak Portuguese. They have some differences in their words. We will learn about that soon.
In real life you might meet a Portuguese speaker. You can start by saying olá and smiling brightly.
A common mistake is using only one word for thank you. Remember to check if you are a boy or a girl.

items: Say obrigado if you are male
Say obrigada if you are female

faq.q: Why do I need to say different words for thank you?
faq.a: Because the word changes depending on the gender of the person speaking it. You must match the word to your own gender.
asks: Is there a different word for thanking?
Do I say different things for thanking?

faq.q: What is the main difference between Brazilian and European Portuguese?
faq.a: The main differences are often in pronunciation and some vocabulary words. We learn these differences as we study more.

faq.q: Can I just use 'hello' instead of 'olá'?
faq.a: You can use English, but saying olá shows you are trying to speak Portuguese. It is a good start.

faq.q: What should I say when I leave a friend?
faq.a: You can say até logo. It is a nice way to say see you later in Portuguese.
No, remember that 'obrigado' is only for boys. Girls must say 'obrigada'.
asks: Does it matter if I say it wrong?

facts: A boy says obrigado when thanking someone.
A girl says obrigada when thanking someone.
Brazil and Portugal are two main regions speaking Portuguese.

quiz.say: If a girl wants to thank someone, what should she say?
quiz.why: Obrigada is the correct form to use when the speaker is female.

wrong.1: Olá means hello, not thank you.
wrong.2: Obrigado is only used by boys.

quiz.say: A boy says olá to a new friend. What does olá mean?
quiz.why: Olá is the standard word for saying hello in Portuguese.

quiz.say: If you are a boy and you receive a gift, what do you say?
quiz.why: Since you are a boy, you must use the masculine form, obrigado.

wrong.0: Olá is used when greeting someone.
wrong.3: This is the word for girls.
